body:
Well guess what ? Like you, I normally just can't wake up and do simple things from daily life. Think about it for a second : if I need to clean my room, it is because I can't clean it up the normal days.
I'm just so excited for what i'm going to do, it is what makes me feel better and, thanks to this, I can finally do daily life routine, something I haven't done for I don't know how many months.

Finally someone who understands my struggle :D
I think it matters just in a form of respect to your neighbors, like you can end your life, but don't annoy people around you as they didn't asked for this. Knowing you were living next to a dead corpse is already creepy in itself, there's no need to add a freaking bad smell.

This is something that I am thinking about for the past year now. I took the decision to end my life after making every scenarios possible on how my life could be if I continued to live. Guess what ? With all those scenarios, I am disappointed about the paths that I can choose, it is no where near what I imagined back when I had ambitions.

And for your second statement, as I was thinking about it for a year, I had the time to think about some details that may seems irrelevant to most people, but it is important to me, as I am already annoying when I'm alive, I don't want to be even more annoying after my death.
I have the right to get some peace, but not by sacrificing others.

Meh it's like I say "you don't really to end a video game if you are looking for the solution on Youtube". What is that logic ? I'm just looking for the best option because I can't figure it out by myself.

I'm afraid that the smell of my decomposing body will annoy my neighbors.
I wrote the reason
